PD-16.text: Whats the story with occupancy?  Sounded like its going well when we were there.

Gulf Breeze MHC, 2026-08 warehouse snapshot: 39 units, 74.4% occupied, $22,230 in-place rent, 63.4% NOI margin.

So the level is below the de-duplicated portfolio average of 77.67%. But the direction is what you were picking up on the visit: Gulf Breeze is one of the named real-absorption properties in the same snapshot, +5 units. Soft level, good trend.

That makes this decision more urgent rather than less. At 74% there is vacancy the company could be leasing itself, and a resident renting their unit out is competing for the same tenant. The portfolio-wide investor-application policy is already moving; this row is the carve-out that never got ruled on.

One caveat on any occupancy number for this property: an archived xGulf Breeze MHP record also carries 39 units, so a figure pulled without de-duplicating will be wrong.
